products.name: Hub
products.tagline: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions like 5
products.description: Open-source dispatcher for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Write a goal in your browser or Telegram, a coordinator hands it to agents, and only the decisions come back. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. One-line install. Experimental: agents run without permission prompts.

products.name: QA.tech MCP
products.tagline: Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents
products.description: QA.tech MCP gives Claude Code, Cursor or Codex an external QA agent to check their work. It runs E2E tests on what each change does to your product and finds the bugs and edge cases your coding agent missed, so they get fixed before the PR goes to review. Stay in your IDE: QA.tech explores your app, writes the tests and runs them. Your coding agent reads the results and fixes what broke. Works with any MCP client. New to QA.tech? One prompt maps your app and kicks off your first test.

products.name: Contral
products.tagline: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you
products.description: Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

products.name: ExtraOrbital
products.tagline: ✦ Open bar databases, storage buckets & AI keys for agents
products.description: Your app needs databases, storage, caching, AI keys, and more. That's dozens of accounts, API keys, invoices, and backups to manage. Agents can't stand it. They don't even have access. You feel like their credentials go-fetch puppet. ExtraOrbital reads yourenv.example file and creates all these ressources for you. It's a CLI, so your agents can use it. They don't even need an account. You gain back control, increase security and manage everything in a central dashboard. Bye bye,env hell !

products.name: Periscope
products.tagline: Turn any work into an API
products.description: Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

products.name: Bifura
products.tagline: See your website the way AI agents do
products.description: AI assistants now read websites for your buyers. Bifura fetches your page the way AI crawlers do, shows what they get and get wrong, and lets you test fixes in a sandbox before you ship. Free Agent readiness score in under a minute, no signup.

products.name: Pushary Calls
products.tagline: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.
products.description: Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

products.name: Pax by Pydantic
products.tagline: A coding agent where even coding is a plugin
products.description: Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal. Every part is a plugin, it runs any model, and --agent runs your own Pydantic AI agent in it.

products.name: Kagi Mail
products.tagline: Private email that puts people who need you first
products.description: Kagi Mail is a private email service designed to help you focus on what matters. Its intelligent inbox highlights people waiting for your reply, identifies emails that need action, and keeps newsletters and unwanted messages out of the way. Ask questions about your inbox, organize emails using natural-language rules, and use unlimited aliases and custom domains. No ads, no tracking, no profiling. Includes 50 GB storage and a built-in calendar, with open standards and no vendor lock-in.

products.name: Doodle
products.tagline: The stick figure on your taskbar that answers questions
products.description: Doodle is a little AI companion that lives on your Windows taskbar. Ask it anything with Ctrl+Shift+Space, or dictate into any app. When it can't do something, Doodle Evolution builds a bespoke plugin, shows you what it can reach, and waits for your OK.

products.name: Clary
products.tagline: iOS notifications in sender's own voice from WhatsApp & more
products.description: Clary reads your iPhone notifications in the sender's own voice, from WhatsApp, iMessage and more. It uses voice cloning: each person records 20 seconds once, from a link, and agrees first, then Clary makes their voice on your iPhone. Tap a message to hear it in their voice, so you feel closer to your people. It also keeps your notifications as a history on your iPhone, sorted Gmail-style into Messages, Updates and Promotions. Free: history, sorting and 2 plays. Needs iPhone 15 Pro+ and iOS 27.

products.name: Monton
products.tagline: AI agents that do your agency's busywork
products.description: Monton is agency management software with AI agents built in. Agents watch budgets, chase overdue invoices, write client reports and remind people about missing hours, on your real hours, staffing, billing and CRM data. Pick one of 18 templates or describe it in a chat. Every email waits for your approval. AI is included in every paid plan: no credits, no per-seat pricing. Free up to 5 people.

products.name: DeskFleet
products.tagline: Run coding agents together across your team’s machines
products.description: DeskFleet gives your team a shared session with the coding agents you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor where your code lives. A teammate can join from their laptop, review the diff, approve the next command, or take control of the remote desktop. Your tools and agent credentials stay on the machine doing the work.

products.name: Remora
products.tagline: The long-term memory layer for AI agents
products.description: Remora is continuous memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest conversations, deduplicate facts, and recall relevant context in under 15ms. Powered by PostgreSQL + pgvector with native Python & TypeScript SDKs. Stop re-inventing memory tables.

products.name: Nookdeck
products.tagline: Turn your old phone into a Stream Deck for your computer
products.description: Nookdeck turns an old phone or tablet into a touch control panel for your Mac or Windows PC. A small app on the computer serves the panel to the phone's browser over Wi-Fi: no app to install on the phone, no account, no cloud. Old iPhones on iOS 12 work too. Buttons for shortcuts, apps, media and macros; live tiles for system stats, Now Playing and weather; Home Assistant controls; Claude and Codex usage; plugins and theme packs. Free and open source (MIT).
